missed_subsystems: CI/CD pipeline — GitHub Actions workflows (.github/workflows/e2e-test.yml runs MongoDB + app + Cypress on push/PR; .github/workflows/lint.yml) and Travis CI (.travis.yml). A build/test trust boundary entirely absent from recon. Low risk in this target (persist-credentials:false, no committed CI secrets), but it is a distinct subsystem not represented by any recon component.

Heroku deployment manifests — Procfile (web: forever server.js) and app.json (one-click deploy: postdeploy runs artifacts/db-reset.js, declares MONGODB_URI/NODE_ENV/NPM_CONFIG_ONLY env). A deployment path/exposure separate from the Docker/compose path that recon captured as C21.
notes:
Independently inventoried the full repo tree (server.js, app/routes/*, app/data/*, app/views/*, config/*, artifacts/*, Dockerfile, docker-compose.yml, Procfile, app.json, .github/workflows/*, .travis.yml, Gruntfile.js, test/*).

Recon coverage of the application runtime surface is strong and accurate:
- Routes: all 15 entry points in app/routes/index.js are present in recon (/, login GET/POST, signup GET/POST, logout, dashboard, profile GET/POST, contributions GET/POST, benefits GET/POST, allocations/:userId, memos GET/POST, /learn open-redirect, /research SSRF, /tutorial/*, static serving). Recon correctly tags the planted vulns (contributions eval, allocations $where NoSQL injection + IDOR, benefits missing isAdmin, /learn open redirect, /research SSRF).
- DAOs: all 7 (user, profile, allocations, contributions, benefits, memos, research) covered. Verified profile-dao (plaintext SSN/DOB/bank), user-dao (plaintext password compare, bcrypt present-but-unused), benefits-dao.
- Data stores: 5 Mongo collections (users, allocations, contributions, memos, counters) + in-memory session store + committed TLS key/cert + static assets — all present.
- Trust boundaries: all 5 (HTTP edge/no TLS, unauth->auth, auth->admin, app->Mongo, app->external fetch) present.
- External deps + deployment: express/mongodb2.x/swig/marked0.3.5/needle/bcrypt-nodejs/node-esapi + node:12-alpine EOL + Dockerfile/compose all captured (C21, X1-X8).

Real gaps vs repo: (1) the CI/CD pipeline (2 GitHub Actions workflows + Travis) is a whole subsystem/trust-boundary with NO recon entry; (2) Heroku deploy manifests Procfile/app.json (distinct from the Docker path recon did capture). Both are genuine missed subsystems but secondary risk — no security-critical exposure hides there that the covered surface doesn't already imply. Net assessment: the coverage denominator is essentially trustworthy; flagged omissions are deployment/CI-tier, not application-tier, so percent-coverage on the dangerous app surface is not materially inflated. Surface counts are approximate tallies (recon: 21 components + 8 stores + 15 entry points + 5 boundaries + 8 deps = 57; independent adds CI/CD pipeline + Travis + Procfile + app.json = ~61).
